# Rent Coat Co.

> Rent Coat Co. (rentcoat.co) is an independent clothing brand that makes heavyweight, garment-dyed graphic tees for young members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Every design starts with a Book of Mormon reference printed on the shirt. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Church.

## About
- Name: from Alma 46:12–13, where Captain Moroni "rent his coat," fastened it to a pole, and called it the title of liberty.
- Sells in limited 7-day preorder drops. Shirts are printed to order and ship 2 to 3 weeks after the drop closes.
- Blank: Comfort Colors 1717, 100% ring-spun cotton, garment-dyed, unisex S to 2XL, true to size.
- Price: $36 USD per tee ($39 for 2XL). Shipping: flat $5.99, US addresses only.
- Email: rentcoat.co@gmail.com
- Instagram: @rentcoat.co
- TikTok: @rentcoat.co

## Drop 001
- [Title of Liberty Tee](https://rentcoat.co/#liberty): flagship. Torn banner on a pole. Color Pepper. Reference Alma 46:12.
- [Stripling 2000 Tee](https://rentcoat.co/#stripling): varsity back print for the 2,000 stripling warriors, quote "We do not doubt our mothers knew it." Color Hemp. Reference Alma 56:48.
- [Cureloms & Cumoms Wildlife Society Tee](https://rentcoat.co/#cureloms): field-guide print of the animals in Ether 9:19. Color Butter.

## Policies
- Returns: no fit returns on made-to-order shirts; damaged or misprinted shirts replaced free within 30 days of delivery.
- Cancellations: free until the drop closes; after that, shirts go to print.
- Privacy: no cookies, analytics or ad tracking on rentcoat.co; personal information is never sold.
